content.value_statement: SpecDD projects need clear scope and authority before implementation starts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused planning.
actual_capabilities: Identifies whether a project has the required SpecDD bootstrap file.
Defines the bootstrap files to read before planning work.
Guides resolution of the effective spec chain for a target.
Requires explicit write authority before implementation begins.
Produces practical plans with scope, risks, blockers, and verification.
limitations: It is only intended for projects that already use SpecDD.
It does not implement code changes while planning.
It depends on existing bootstrap and spec files for authority.
It does not replace human review of unclear product decisions.

use_cases.title: Plan a SpecDD change
use_cases.description: Resolve the governing specs and authority before asking an agent to edit files.

use_cases.title: Review implementation scope
use_cases.description: Identify affected files, constraints, risks, and verification before work begins.

use_cases.title: Prepare agent handoff
use_cases.description: Create a concise plan that another AI coding agent can follow safely.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a small change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-plan to plan this small change. Identify the target scope, governing specs, write authority, and verification.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve unclear authority
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-plan to resolve whether this target has write authority. List blockers and questions before any edits.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare implementation path
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-plan for this feature request. Summarize constraints, likely changed files, risks, and the smallest safe implementation path.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a complex request
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-plan to analyze this cross-area request. Compare spec constraints, identify conflicts, and define required verification.

output_examples.input: Plan a change to update validation behavior in a SpecDD project.
output_examples.output: A scoped plan naming the target, governing specs, allowed files, validation risks, blockers, and likely tests.

output_examples.input: Determine whether an agent can edit a module under SpecDD rules.
output_examples.output: An authority summary that cites the needed spec chain and lists unresolved permission questions.

output_examples.input: Prepare a handoff plan for a cross-directory feature.
output_examples.output: A practical implementation path with affected areas, required constraints, verification steps, and open decisions.

best_practices: Start with the exact target path, behavior, or task before planning.
Read only the governing specs needed for the current decision.
Record blockers when authority or verification is unclear.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to adopt SpecDD in a non-SpecDD project.
Do not infer write authority from nearby filenames or conventions.
Do not turn the plan into a broad refactor proposal.

faq.question: What is specdd-plan for?
faq.answer: It helps an AI agent plan SpecDD work before editing files.

faq.question: Does it change project files?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly focuses on planning and authority checks before implementation.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when scope, specs, write authority, risk, or verification need clarification.

faq.question: Does it require an existing SpecDD project?
faq.answer: Yes. It expects a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file to exist.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it replace spec review?
faq.answer: No. It guides focused reading of the relevant bootstrap and spec files.
